name: sezanzeb/input-remapper
description: Easy-to-use Linux tool for remapping input devices including keyboards, mice, gamepads, joysticks, and wheels. Supports X11, Wayland, programmable macros, and is widely used for accessibility adaptations.
score_rationale: Most popular open-source Linux input remapper with 5.5k stars, actively maintained through November 2025, GPL-3.0, and essential for accessibility and gaming input customization.
summary: Linux input remapper for accessibility and gaming
